capabilities: Edit whole-note, heading, block and list-item embeds in place
Save edits to the embedded note automatically
Limit editing to notes carrying given tags
Open the embedded note from the embed
Refresh embeds when the source note changes elsewhere
disambiguation: Not about making media or file embeds editable; it only turns embeds of notes, headings and blocks into editors.
extras: Relies on Obsidian internals outside the public API, so app updates may break it. Self-embeds and embeds nested more than 3 levels deep stay read-only; tag changes need the embedding note reopened.
problem: Embeds in Obsidian are read-only previews, so changing an embedded section means opening the source note and locating the text yourself.

relations.evidence: The way the editor is put inside an embed comes from Outliner.MD by Boninall (Quorafind).

summary: Makes note, heading, block and list-item embeds editable in place in Live Preview, writing changes back to the embedded note as you type.
